column1: To limit spam, the server computes an encrypted fingerprint (HMAC) of your IP address and of your phone’s random identifier. Neither the IP address nor the identifier is stored in the clear. The key is drawn at random for each period (6 hours for the IP address, one day for the phone), then destroyed at the end of the following period: even with a copy of the disk, past fingerprints can no longer be computed, and two days cannot be linked. Within one period, however, the server can link the actions of the same phone (one day) or the same network (6 hours).
column2: To limit spam, the server computes an encrypted fingerprint (HMAC) of your IP address and of your phone’s random identifier. Neither the IP address nor the identifier is stored in the clear. The key is drawn at random for each period (6 hours for the IP address, one day for the phone), then destroyed at the end of the following period: even with a copy of the disk, past fingerprints can no longer be computed, and two days cannot be linked. Within one period, however, the server can link the actions of the same phone (one day) or the same network (6 hours).
column3: Para limitar el spam, el servidor calcula una huella cifrada (HMAC) de tu dirección IP y del identificador aleatorio de tu teléfono. Ni la dirección IP ni el identificador se guardan en claro. La clave se genera al azar para cada periodo (6 horas para la dirección IP, un día para el teléfono) y se destruye al final del periodo siguiente: aun con una copia del disco, ya no se pueden recalcular las huellas pasadas, y no se pueden relacionar dos días entre sí. Dentro de un mismo periodo, en cambio, el servidor puede relacionar las acciones de un mismo teléfono (un día) o de una misma red (6 horas).
column4: للحد من الرسائل المزعجة، يحسب الخادم بصمة مشفّرة (HMAC) لعنوان IP الخاص بك وللمعرّف العشوائي لهاتفك. لا يُحفظ عنوان IP ولا المعرّف بشكل واضح. يُولَّد المفتاح عشوائيًا لكل فترة (6 ساعات لعنوان IP، ويوم للهاتف)، ثم يُتلف في نهاية الفترة التالية: حتى مع نسخة من القرص، لا يمكن إعادة حساب البصمات السابقة، ولا يمكن الربط بين يومين. أما داخل الفترة نفسها، فيمكن للخادم أن يربط بين أفعال الهاتف نفسه (يوم) أو الشبكة نفسها (6 ساعات).

column1: The technical address your browser provides for notifications, your area rounded to about 10 km, your choices (urgent announcements, dangers near you, new orders), the app’s language and the time of the last “danger” alert (so you don’t get more than one every 3 minutes). Notification content is end-to-end encrypted to your phone; it includes the public reports active around your area, so the map stays up to date without a network. Notifications go through your browser’s service (Google for Chrome and Android, Apple for Safari and iPhone, Mozilla for Firefox, Microsoft for Edge on Windows): it sees that a notification is sent to you, when, and its size, never its content.

Notifications go through your browser’s service (Google for Chrome and Android, Apple for Safari and iPhone, Mozilla for Firefox, Microsoft for Edge on Windows): it sees that a notification is sent to you, when, and its size, never its content.
